fusions.name: Cold Slam
fusions.desc: Slams down, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning them for 1 second.

fusions.name: Stiffening Snap
fusions.desc: Snaps at a target up to 4 tiles away, dealing 7 damage, rising to 1.4 times that from the full 4 tiles. Anything struck moves 25% slower for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Basking Ledge
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Sun-Warmed Rock
fusions.desc: In daylight, your armour rises by 12%.
